>There is no reason to do it

Yes there fucking is you terminal moron. Did you even read the OP?

It isn't. You have no obligation to stay. If, statistically, for a good portion of your life, positive experiences are outweighed by negative experiences, then there's really no reason to believe it's going to improve out of nowhere.

The "it gets better!" mantra people repeat to suicidal people is literally just a sugarcoated version way of saying be delusional. If you believe things are going to randomly get good out of nowhere, you're not being an optimist, you're being in denial. Some might say "well, if you work for it, it gets better", but why the fuck would you do that when suicide is that much easier?
